description: A security audit of your ManageEngine EventLog Analyzer deployment has identified several configuration issues that must be remediated. Your tasks are: (1) navigate to Settings > Technicians & Roles and identify technician accounts that were incorrectly granted Administrator privileges — specifically, the accounts 'contractor01' and 'it-support' should not have Admin access and must be downgraded to Operator role, (2) create a new technician account with Username: 'soc-analyst-02', Full Name: 'SOC Analyst Two', Email: 'soc2@company.local', and Role: Operator, (3) review the existing alert profiles and identify at least 2 that are configured with 'Warning' severity but should be 'Critical' — update their severity to Critical (look for alerts related to brute force, failed logins, or unauthorized access that are set to Warning), and (4) document all changes in a file at ~/Desktop/hardening_report.txt listing: usernames downgraded, the new account created, and which alert names were updated to Critical severity. Log in with username: admin, password: admin.
